overloads.semanticRole: Imports the 4D View Pro document contained in vpBlob into the 4D View Pro area vpAreaName, replacing its contents.

constraints: vpBlob must contain a 4D View Pro document previously saved as a Blob via VP EXPORT TO BLOB or the 4D View Pro interface.
The import replaces any data already present in vpAreaName.

paramObj is an options object; documented defaults include calcOnDemand=false, dynamicReferences=true, fullRecalc=false, includeFormulas=true, includeStyles=true, includeUnusedStyles=true, and an optional formula callback invoked when the import completes.
